description: Show existing authorized tracking groups across their configured platforms. Reads stored configuration without collection, refresh or setup; no new collection cost. Use the returned group ID and workspace for subsequent reads. Groups overlap, so summed items_count is not the tracked total; socialseal_get_tracking_inventory returns that total.

workspaceId.description: Optional workspace override. Omit only when the user can reach a single workspace.

name: socialseal_list_tracking_groups
title: list tracking groups
